<div class="card-body">
'''Friendly Fire''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">同士討ち</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手のキャラクターが2名以上、武器が1つ以上ある位置で戦闘が起きた場合に使う。運命数を引く。運命数＜（その位置の相手のキャラクターの数）ならば、キャラクターの1名がロストする（相手が選ぶ）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-80o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">狭い場所で多くの銃を乱射すれば、当然、仲間を撃つ可能性も出てくる。だがストームトルーパーは、勝利を得るためには、同士討ちすらいとわない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Friendly fire.

'''Card text:''' Use at a battle where the opponent has at least two characters and one weapon. Draw destiny. If destiny < the number of the opponent's characters there, one is lost (opponent's choice).

'''Lore:''' Firing many guns in a tight space can hit one's own. Stormtroopers still accept friendly fire if it wins the fight.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Friendly Fire]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
